يجتذبن (form VIII)
# يَجْتَذِبْنَ (yajtaḏibna) /jad͡ʒ.ta.ðib.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# يُجْتَذَبْنَ (yujtaḏabna) /jud͡ʒ.ta.ðab.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
